author: National Geographic
description:
Situated on Spain's northern coast, Santander is often overlooked by those outside of Spain, but the arrival of two world-class art museums is fueling a cultural renaissance in this port city. Beyond its museums and galleries, the sandy beaches, fresh seafood, and beautifully curated parks—like the Pereda Gardens, which were transformed by landscape architect Fernando Caruncho in 2014—offer even more reasons to visit the Cantabrian capital.

author: National Geographic
description: From sweeping sand dunes and historic buildings to cutting-edge skyline landmarks, Abu Dhabi is a place of remarkable contrast. National Geographic photographer Matthieu Paley shares his perspective on capturing the Louvre Abu Dhabi, where ocean waters meet a canopy-inspired dome, and why he hopes to return to photograph the architectural ambition of the Guggenheim Abu Dhabi alongside the centuries-old irrigation and harvesting traditions of Al Ain Oasis.
